versions.content: Service Name E2E_ P01Protect Syntax Std_ Return Type E2E_ P01Protect ( const E2E_ P01Config Type* Config Ptr, E2E_ P01Protect State Type* State Ptr, uint8* Data Ptr ) Service ID [hex] 0x01 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Config Ptr Pointer to static configuration. Parameters (inout) State Ptr Pointer to port/ data communication state. Data Ptr Pointer to Data to be transmitted. Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E2E_ E_ INPUTERR_ NULL E2E_ E_ INPUTERR_ WRONG E2E_ E_ INTERR E2E_ E_ OK For definitions for return values, see SWS_ E2E_00047. Description Protects the array/ buffer to be transmitted using the E2E profile 1. This includes checksum calculation, handling of counter and Data ID. Available via E2E.h
